sections.readyMadeTemplatesDescription: Pre-built, ready-to-use sections — insert one and customize it.

templates.heading: Sub Templates
templates.description: Reusable pieces you've saved. Save a section as a template to reuse it across pages.
templates.empty: You haven't saved any templates yet.
templates.deleteConfirmDescription: Are you sure want to delete this template?

importHtmlDialog.title: Import HTML
importHtmlDialog.description: Paste HTML — a full page or a fragment — and we'll convert it into editable sections. The structure and the style attributes are converted. JavaScript, external stylesheets and CSS in <style> blocks show in the editor but are not saved; contact support if you need them.
importHtmlDialog.replaceWarning: This replaces everything currently on this page. This can't be undone except with Ctrl+Z.
importHtmlDialog.nothingConverted: Nothing convertible was found in that HTML
importHtmlDialog.skipped: Some elements have no editor equivalent and were skipped: {{tags}}
importHtmlDialog.tailwindUnsupported: {{count}} Tailwind class(es) have no equivalent in the editor and were left out: {{classes}}
importHtmlDialog.externalFiles: These linked files aren't in the pasted HTML, so they weren't included — paste their code into Custom Code: {{files}}

aiPrompt.title: Generate the HTML with AI
aiPrompt.description: Copy this prompt into ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini to get HTML that imports cleanly. Fill in Part 1 (green) with your page details; Part 2 holds the rules the importer needs, including the style format (Tailwind classes, no CSS or JavaScript code).

canChange.purpose: Page purpose, audience and copy language
canChange.sections: Which sections, their order and how many cards
canChange.content: Event details, dates, links and wording

keep.skeleton: The fixed page skeleton: one section per block
keep.format: One html block, with no <style> and no <script>
keep.structure: Sections directly in <body>; text in h1-h6, p, ul
keep.css: All styling as Tailwind classes (hover, active, animation and on-view included)
keep.js: No JavaScript: use details/summary for an FAQ

aiPrompt.howTo: Paste the AI's whole reply below and click Import.
aiPrompt.copied: Prompt copied - paste it into your AI tool
aiPrompt.copyFailed: Couldn't copy - select the text and copy it manually

importHtmlDialog.uploadHint: Paste your HTML below, or load a file from your computer.

importHtmlDialog.fileTooLarge: That file is too large (max {{mb}} MB)

codeReview.title: Code for review
codeReview.copyHint: Copy the code below and send it with your request, so our team can check it.

codeReview.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.
codeReview.empty: This page has no CSS or JavaScript to review. Code from imported HTML shows here until you leave or reload the page.

randomLayoutDialog.title: Generate Random Layout
randomLayoutDialog.description: Pick what should be eligible, then we'll randomly assemble a full page from your selections. This replaces your current page content.
randomLayoutDialog.selectAtLeastOne: Select at least one option to generate from
randomLayoutDialog.replaceWarning: This will replace all current page content. This can only be undone with Ctrl+Z.
